editedExercise.name: Reverse Crunch

instructions.description: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides and your knees bent. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Lift your legs until your knees are bent at approximately 90° and your calves are roughly parallel to the floor. Gently engage your core and keep your lower back stable.
Using your abdominal muscles, gently curl your pelvis off the floor and bring your knees toward your chest. Keep the movement small and controlled rather than lifting the hips high.
Slowly lower your pelvis and return your legs to the starting position without letting them drop. Repeat with controlled movement and steady breathing.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.

commentsNotes: Initiate the movement with your abs and pelvic curl, not by swinging your legs.
Keep your shoulders and head relaxed on the floor.
Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower.
